name: research-mapping
description: Pre-review surface for Research Mapping: read the formal graph, read the same-time reviewable candidate set with its exact heads, append prereview reports and invalidation decisions, and create one merged candidate.
notes: No formalize_candidate, no reconcile_formalization, no preview_candidate, no create_merge_request, no record_review. Those are the Project Owner's adjudication: a Centre Agent that could also approve would collapse pre-review and decision into one actor, which is the reason the two suites exist separately.

append_prereview_log is append-only. A moved candidate head or base is never repaired by editing an earlier report; it is answered by appending an invalidation decision with reason=head_moved or reason=base_moved.

create_merged_candidate takes source_proposal_ids and a change_set. It creates a new branch and never edits the sources; a merged candidate may not be merged again, and the source authors get no operation rights over the result.

tools.name: get_formal_mapping
tools.description: Read the current formal Research Mapping graph for a domain. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: get_formal_mapping_at_revision
tools.description: Read the exact formal Research Mapping snapshot pinned by a specific formal_revision_id (historical activated revision), using the same consistency gates as the current pointer read. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: Read the candidate record associated with a submission. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: list_reviewable_candidates
tools.description: Read the same-time reviewable candidate set (not merged, rejected or abandoned) with exact candidate head, base formal revision and immutable content snapshot. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: append_prereview_log
tools.description: Append one prereview report, or one invalidation decision, to the Mapping governance log. Append-only: reports and decisions are never edited. Passing ``reason`` (head_moved/base_moved) appends an invalidation decision; otherwise a report row is appended under the (candidate_id, candidate_head, rule_set_version, base_formal_revision_id) unique key. Requires the centre capability.

tools.name: create_merged_candidate
tools.description: Create one merged Mapping candidate branch from source candidates on the same formal base. Only creates a new branch; existing candidates are never edited. The author field records every source author; source authors get no operation rights; a merged candidate may not be merged again. Requires the merged_candidate capability.
